name: Tactec SplitPanel Prosthetic Cargo Short
description: Knee-length cargo shorts in olive-tan ripstop with full-length magnetic-close split panels on both outer legs — panels that open completely from hip to hem, allowing prosthetic legs to be removed or serviced without removing the shorts. Popular in warm-weather zones and among aug users who need fast field maintenance access. Two cargo pockets per side, reinforced with bar-tack stitching.
functionality: Full-length split panels on both legs open magnetically for complete prosthetic removal and field maintenance without undressing.
what_it_says: Practical over everything. You've thought through your logistics.
story_hooks: Someone swapped out their prosthetics in a bathroom stall before crossing a checkpoint — the split panels made it a thirty-second job.
The magnetic closures read on certain scanners; a character wearing these gets flagged at a security gate for no obvious reason.

physical_description.visual_profile: Utilitarian knee-length cargo shorts with a distinctive modular aesthetic. The split panels create vertical lines down both outer legs, giving the silhouette an intentionally deconstructed, tech-forward appearance. Reads as functional and purpose-built rather than fashion-forward.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed, straight-leg cut through the thigh with subtle taper at the knee. Designed for comfort over augmented limbs and frequent panel manipulation. Sits at natural waistline with reinforced belt loops.
physical_description.primary_material: Olive-tan ripstop nylon composite — military-spec abrasion resistance with slight sheen under direct light
physical_description.texture: Tightly woven ripstop grid texture visible at close range, creating a subtle pattern across the surface. Panels feature smooth magnetic closure trim with minimal tactile feedback.
physical_description.color_scheme: Muted olive-tan base with darker tan reinforcement stitching and charcoal magnetic closure strips along panel edges
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snaps running the full length of both outer leg split panels (hip to hem), allowing complete panel separation. Traditional button fly on waistband.
distinctive_features: Full-length magnetic split panels on both outer legs
Four cargo pockets total (two per side) with reinforced bar-tack stitching
Contrasting dark stitching at stress points
Integrated cable routing guides along interior seams
Tactec branding on right thigh pocket in subdued embroidery
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional. Quality construction and specialized design indicate working-class prosperity or lower-mid corpo adoption.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by prosthetic users, field technicians, maintenance workers, and aug-communities in warm climates. Signals practical priorities over appearance — wearer values access and serviceability.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in but maintained. Mild fading in high-stress areas around cargo pockets and magnetic closures. No major damage, but visible creasing from repeated panel opening.
